end.summary:
Aarav practised ordering dates on a BCE/CE timeline.
They identified 500 BCE as earlier than 1 BCE and 1 CE.
They placed 1947 CE to the right and discussed the transition from 1 BCE to 1 CE.
Aarav repeatedly requested a drawn timeline; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised sequencing BCE and CE dates with Aarav, including 500 BCE, 1 BCE, 1 CE, and 1947 CE. Aarav used the rule that BCE numbers move backwards and asked for a visual line to place the dates. No clear mix-up was corrected later in the lesson; the requested drawn timeline was not shown. At home, draw a simple line together and place 500 BCE, 300 BCE, 1 BCE, 1 CE, and 1947 CE on it.
